date_note: Date is Dailysecu's publication day; the company says files were downloaded 5-15 November and found on 18 November.
title: AMC Insurance Brokerage claims app AMC air hacked, personal and medical data leaked, Dailysecu reports
summary: Dailysecu reports, citing the company, that an outside party downloaded claims-list and member-list files from the AMC air claims app between 5 and 15 November, affecting employees of some client companies. The company found it on 18 November, suspended the service and reported to relevant agencies. Data may include resident registration numbers and, for claimants, diagnosis and treatment details. The number affected was not disclosed.
plain: A South Korean insurance brokerage's claims app was hacked, and some corporate clients' employees' personal data, possibly including medical details, was taken. The number of people was not disclosed.
exec: A claims app exposed identity numbers and possibly health details, which can fuel fraud and impersonation against affected employees.
action: Affected users: watch for phishing and fraud posing as insurers, hospitals or public bodies, check for misuse of your identity, and change any password reused elsewhere, as the company advises.

validation.note: Only Dailysecu read; the company's homepage notice it cites was not read. Intrusion route, number affected and agencies reported to are not stated.

review.note: Checked against Dailysecu: dates 5-15 Nov and 18 Nov, suspension, agency report, data types, undisclosed count match. Plain said corporate clients' employees but summary did not; added 'affecting employees of some client companies' to summary.
